evidence.quote:
Do rattlesnakes and prairie-dogs live together in harmony, and will a
female grizzly recognize its own offspring after it has been away
from, it for twenty-four hours.
evidence.paraphrase: The professor states the two natural-history questions he has come to investigate.

evidence.quote:
Professor Manning\u2019s theory is wrong, and I am
going to prove it.
evidence.paraphrase: The professor frames his trip as testing and disproving a rival scholar's theory.

evidence.quote:
I shall expect you to furnish me with the opportunity to carry out
this experiment to a satisfactory conclusion
evidence.paraphrase: The professor describes hiring the men to enable his experiment on the grizzly's maternal instinct.

evidence.quote: That\u2019s uh \u2014\u2014 of uh reason fer comin\u2019 way up here!
evidence.paraphrase: Magpie reacts with derision to the professor's stated reason for the trip.

evidence.quote:
Can\u2019t I believe my own eyes?\u201d wails th\u2019 ol\u2019 pelican. \u201cCan\u2019t I see
these things?
evidence.paraphrase: The professor insists on the validity of his own observations.

evidence.quote: My husband, being a scientist, is very observing
evidence.paraphrase: The professor's wife characterizes him as a scientist who observes carefully.

evidence.quote: All I hope is that I get some good shooting.
evidence.paraphrase: The doctor voices his hope for good shooting on the trip.

evidence.quote:
the most important is the test of the maternal instinct in the grizzly
bear.
evidence.paraphrase: The professor identifies testing grizzly maternal instinct as his main goal.

evidence.quote:
I hope I can get some good action in a bear picture,\u201d states th\u2019 doc.
\u201cIt will help in provin\u2019 th\u2019 perfessor\u2019s experiments.
evidence.paraphrase: The doctor plans to photograph the bear as evidence for the experiment.

evidence.quote:
I was right!\u201d he squeaks. \u201cI told Professor Manning that the parent
bear would seek and find its young.
evidence.paraphrase: The professor declares his prediction about parental instinct confirmed.

evidence.quote:
My contention is
proved, and we can leave at once.
evidence.paraphrase: The professor concludes his contention has been proven and decides to depart.

evidence.quote:
Reason, eh? By cripes, Magpie, that\u2019s uh fightin\u2019 word with th\u2019 Jones
fambly from now on and ever more.
evidence.paraphrase: Mighty reacts bitterly, declaring the word 'reason' offensive after his ordeal.
